tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: What Car Rental Brain measures, how fresh it is, and which airports/countries are covered. Use first when unsure whether a place is covered.

tools.name: list_airports
tools.description: Airports we measure, with the typical rental price per day. Filter by country. Use to find an airport id or to list what is covered in a country.

tools.name: airport_costs
tools.description: The true cost of hiring a car at one airport: per-day price for the car alone, with a second driver, with full cover, automatic, no-deposit (from + typical); by pick-up month; second-driver fees; deposits; debit-card acceptance; desk closing times and out-of-hours fees; policies. Use when someone as

tools.name: compare_airports
tools.description: Rank airports by real cost (car only / with driver / with cover), typical deposit, debit-card frendliness or late desk hours. Use for 'where in Spain is car hire cheapest in March?' or 'which airport is best for a debit card?'

tools.name: supplier_terms
tools.description: Per supplier at an airport: typical price per day, second-driver fee, full-cover price, deposit held, whether the desk takes a debit card, and customers' desk review scores. Use when the person is choosing between suppliers at one airport or asks about a named supplier.

tools.name: build_search_link
tools.description: A link for the PERSON to open: live prices for their exact dates and needs, ranked by the total they will actually pay, where they can book. Use whenever the person has dates and wants to see or book cars.
